text: dsh-image-skin 是面向 DSH 网页客户端的图片皮肤插件，可为窗口、中心区域、侧栏、欢迎页、右侧面板和输入区设置自选图片、GIF 或视频背景。它在网页设置中提供按区域管理的皮肤控制，可分别配置浅色与深色模式、图片填充方式、位置和缩放，并添加可拖动贴纸。面板透明度与输入控件透明度可以单独调整；界面也能从窗口壁纸取色生成配色。适合希望个性化 DSH 网页工作界面的人。图片和设置保存在本机 DSH_HOME 下，不需要额外账号或密钥。

dsh-image-skin adds image, GIF, and video skins to DSH web regions, with separate light and dark artwork, adjustable placement, and draggable stickers. Users can tune panel opacity and derive interface colors from wallpaper. Images and settings stay local under DSH_HOME; no account or key is needed.

dsh-image-skin 的功能「可按区域设置背景」：插件允许为窗口、中心、侧栏、欢迎区、右侧面板和输入区分别选择图片，并设置填充、偏移、缩放与启用状态。 通过网页端图片皮肤设置触发并保存。
dsh-image-skin 的功能「分别配置浅色与深色图片」：每个区域可设置共用图片，也可为浅色和深色模式指定覆盖图；客户端优先采用当前模式专用图，缺省时回退到共用图。 通过网页端图片皮肤设置触发并保存。
dsh-image-skin 的功能「添加可拖动贴纸」：客户端提供贴纸锚点并将其应用于界面区域，配合设置可调整位置与大小，作为网页界面上的装饰图片。 通过网页端图片皮肤设置触发并保存。
dsh-image-skin 的功能「调整视频播放速度」：上传的视频壁纸与贴纸视频可通过统一播放速率设置调节，客户端将速率限制在 0.1 到 4 倍并即时更新现有视频。 通过网页端图片皮肤设置触发并保存。

text:
dsh-image-skin README · What it does：| | |
|---|---|
| 🖼️ **Per-region artwork** | Window backdrop, center column, sidebar, welcome/empty state, right panel, composer — each with its own image, fit mode and on/off switch. |
| 🎬 **Motion** | A looping `mp4`/`webm` as the window backdrop, GIFs anywhere, one slider for playback rate. |
| 🌗 **Light *and* dark, configured separately** | Two independent sets of artwork; flipping the theme swaps the wallpaper too, and a shared image is the fallback. |
| 🧸 **Stickers** | Two free-floating images on the sidebar and the composer — drag to move, drag the corner to scale, positions persist. |
| 🫧 **Panel translucency** | One slider makes DSH's own surfaces see-through so the wallpaper shows through — while the wallpaper itself is deliberately *not* dimmed. |
| 🎨 **The interface takes colour from your picture** | Buttons, inputs, dialogs and rails stop being grey: one hue is sampled from your wallpaper (a real frame, even for video), every step is contrast-checked, and the **depth slider is stepless**. |
| 🪶 **Smooth, and it stays smooth** | Big DOM, long conversation — the cross-fade only animates what a compositor can, and stops touching text

dsh-image-skin README · What it does：> **A feature that came and went.** An early line of work tried *letting a text-to-image model draw an
> ornamental border* around panels ("AI ornament"). We built it, shipped it publicly, and then judged
> it **not good enough** — an ornament frame collapses into a colour clash on a 30px button. The UI
> entry was removed; the code stays in git history (`e19c633` / `34c3002` / `b66006e`). **This version
> does not do that.** The colour screen now does exactly one thing: sample, and tint.

dsh-image-skin README · Why this one：There are several plugins in this space, and most of them do the same thing: take one picture and
generate a colour palette from it. This one takes the opposite approach — **you place artwork
exactly where you want it** — and does a few things the others do not:

dsh-image-skin README · Why this one：- **Artwork, not just a palette.** A window backdrop, a sidebar image, a sticker you can drag — these
  are first-class here. (A single auto-picked colour scheme is *not* what this is.)
- **The whole scheme from one hue.** The sampler's colours are reduced to a single hue; every role
  (hairline / ink / surface) is derived from it and contrast-checked, so the UI *harmonises* instead
  of clashing. The **depth slider** only decides how deeply the colour is laid on
  (淡 / 标准 / 浓 / 呼吸), never *what* gets drawn.
- **Built for the long haul.** Other implementations stutter on a long conversation; this one only
  animates compositor-friendly properties and drops text-colour work on heavy trees.
- **Reversible by design.** Turn it off and nothing is left behind.
dsh-image-skin README · Why this one： *Same interface, another wallpaper — panels, hairlines and ink all re-derive from the new picture.*

dsh-image-skin README · 3. hard-refresh the browser (Ctrl+F5)：> dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-image-skin@0.4.8     # or: pnpm add dsh-image-skin@0.4.8
> ```
> **In the desktop app's plugin installer, type the same thing — `dsh-image-skin@0.4.8`, not just the
> package name.** A bare name is a *range*: pnpm's `minimumReleaseAge` (default: **one week**) only
> auto-picks versions that old, so it will silently install something ancient (measured: `0.3.0`), or
> error with `The latest release of dsh-image-skin is …` when the range you asked for is too new.
> npm i dsh-image-skin@latest --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/
> ```
> (`npm` has no release-age policy, so a bare name is fine there.)
> (The app's own **“禁用第三方插件… / disable third-party plugins”** recovery button also gets you back in.)

dsh-image-skin README · Usage：**Settings → 图片皮肤 / Image skin.** Two screens, usable independently:

**「贴图」/ Images** — put the artwork in:

dsh-image-skin README · Usage：- **正在编辑 / Editing** — a segmented control for 浅色模式 / 深色模式, i.e. *which set of images you
  are editing*. Flipping it also flips the live theme, so you configure what you see.
- **界面区域 / Regions** and **角标贴图 / Stickers** — one card per area: thumbnail, name, where
  its artwork comes from (`浅色专用` / `两模式共用` / `未设置`), and its controls.
- **全局效果 / Global** — panel opacity, video playback rate.
- **存储 / Storage** — `清理未使用图片` collects stored files no area references any more.
- **皮肤包 / Skin pack** — export the whole skin (settings + every referenced image) as one
  `dsh-image-skin-YYYY-MM-DD.pack.json`, or import such a file back. Import adds missing images and
  never deletes stored files; files that already exist are skipped, and `accentApiKey` in a pack is
  ignored (the receiving machine keeps its own key).

dsh-image-skin README · Usage：**「配色」/ Colour** — let the interface follow the picture (**give the Window region an image first**;
the palette is sampled from it):

dsh-image-skin README · Usage：- **Depth, 0 – 4, stepless** — 0 is a whisper (a single hairline), each step lays the colour on more
  deeply and follows the light in the picture. The interface updates *while* you drag.
- **Colour routes** — three, and the difference is visible at a glance:
  - `整屏染色` (*wash*) — every surface carries the hue, hairlines everywhere; the UI reads as soaked in colour;
  - `只染三处` (*marks*) — surfaces stay neutral, only the selection, the focus ring and one rule are coloured;
  - `双声部` (*duo*) — surfaces borrow the main hue, interaction colour uses the picture's **second** hue.
- **取自壁纸 / Sampled** — shows the colours it took, plus the material it recognised
  (sky / paper / wood / water / neon).

dsh-image-skin README · Usage：| Control | Meaning |
|---|---|
| Upload | image, GIF, `mp4` / `webm` (≤ 24 MB) |
| Shared image | one image used by both modes unless a mode overrides it |
| 启用 | per-area on/off |
| 填充 | `cover` / `contain` / `tile` (regions only) |
| 编辑位置 | stickers only — drag to move, corner handle to scale |
| 面板不透明度 | one slider for all DSH surfaces |
| Skin pack | export / import the whole skin (never carries an API key) |

dsh-image-skin README · Usage：Sampling and tinting happen **entirely on your machine**: no network, no cost, no key.

Uploads are optimised **in the browser before they are sent**: anything whose longest edge exceeds
2560 or that is heavier than 700 KB is re-encoded to WebP (q=0.88) on a canvas; GIF, SVG and video
are stored untouched (a canvas would flatten an animation), and a re-encode that comes out larger is
discarded in favour of the original.

dsh-image-skin README · Compatibility：DSH is a Cordis-based app: this plugin is one row in the web profile, contributing a settings
namespace (host) and a `settings.section` page (browser). Region hosts are located through
**CSS-module class-name suffixes** (`_centerCol`, `_sidebarCol`, `_hero`, `_pane`,
`_composerSeat`, …) rather than hashed prefixes, but they are still DSH internals: a release that
renames them can break region targeting. Panel translucency overrides the documented theme tokens
(`--dsw-alias-bg-base`, `--dsw-alias-bg-layer-1/2`, `--dsw-alias-bg-overlay`,
`--dsw-specific-sidebar-fill`, `--dsw-specific-app-shell`) and nothing else.

dsh-image-skin README · Development：```powershell
npm install
npm run build       # src/index.ts -> lib/index.js (ESM host half)
                    # src/client/index.ts -> lib/client.js (browser half, ModuleLoader format)
npm run watch       # rebuild on change

`lib/` is committed on purpose — DSH loads the built halves — and `prepublishOnly` rebuilds it so a
published artifact can never drift from `src/`.

dsh-image-skin README · A note on maintenance 🐢：This is a **student side-project**. I build it in the gaps between classes and coursework, so
replies and fixes can be slow — please bear with me.

That said: **issues, ideas and pull requests are genuinely welcome**, and I read every one.
If you enjoy the plugin, a ⭐ helps a lot — it tells me the thing is worth coming back to.

text:
dsh-image-skin README · 它做什么：| | |
|---|---|
| 🖼️ **按区域贴图** | 整窗口底图、中心列、侧栏、欢迎页、右面板、输入框 —— 各自独立配图、各自选填充方式、各自可开关。 |
| 🎬 **动起来** | 窗口底图能用循环 `mp4` / `webm`，任何区域都能用 GIF；一个滑块统管所有视频的播放速率。 |
| 🌗 **浅色 / 深色分开配** | 两套独立的图；切主题时壁纸跟着换，没单独配的区域回退到「通用图」。 |
| 🧸 **角标贴图** | 侧栏和输入框上各一张自由漂浮的图 —— 拖动挪位置、拖角缩放，位置会记住。 |
| 🫧 **面板透明度** | 一个滑块让 DSH 自己的面板透出背景 —— 而**壁纸本身不会被压暗**（这点是刻意的）。 |
| 🎨 **界面跟着画面配色** | 按钮、输入框、弹窗、轨道不再是灰的：从你的壁纸里取一个色相（视频也能取真帧），逐级做对比度校验后染上去。深浅档位**无级可调**。 |
| 🪶 **流畅，且能一直流畅** | 长对话、大 DOM 也不卡：过渡只走合成器能处理的属性，树太重时停掉文字颜色的活儿。 |
| 🗜️ **上传即优化** | 大图先在浏览器里缩到最长边 2560、转成 WebP 再存（GIF / SVG / 视频原样保留）；重编码反而更大的就留原图。盘更省，设置页也更轻。 |
| 📦 **皮肤包** | 一套皮肤（图 + 全部设置）导出成一个文件，备份、换电脑、送人都行。导入只补不删，**API Key 永远不进包**。 |
| 👁️ **看得清** | 文字色按「壁纸 + 面板透明度合成后的真实背景」算对比度（主 7:1 / 次 5:1 / 淡 4.5:1）；输入框另有单独一档不透明度，面板可以很透，你正在打的字还清楚。 |
| 🔒 **纯本机、可完全撤销** | 文件放在 `$DSH_HOME/image-skin/`。关掉插件，它加过的每一处样式、角标和视频层都会消失。 |

dsh-image-skin README · 它做什么：> **曾经有过、现在没有的功能：** 早期版本试过「让生图模型画一圈花纹边框」（AI 纹样）。
> 这条路我们走了一遍、也公开上线过，最后判断**效果不好**（花纹在 30px 的小按钮上会变成色块打架），
> 界面入口已经撤掉。代码留在 git 历史里（`e19c633` / `34c3002` / `b66006e`），**这一版不做这件事。**
> 现在这一页只做一件事：**取色、配色**。

dsh-image-skin README · 为什么用它：同类插件不少，大多做同一件事：拿一张图，生成一套配色。这个插件反过来 —— **图放哪儿、放多大、透多少，由你说了算** —— 并且多做了几件别人没做的事： - **要的是"贴图"，不只是"配色"。** 整窗底图、侧栏图、能拖的角标，在这里都是一等公民。 - **一套配色从一个色相长出来。** 取色器把画面收敛成**一个色相**，每个角色 （细线 / 文字 / 面）都由它推出来并做对比度校验，所以界面是**和画面和声**，不是打架。 **深浅滑块**只决定这个颜色铺多深（淡 / 标准 / 浓 / 呼吸），**不改变画什么**。 - **为长时间用而做。** 别的实现在长对话里会卡；这个只动画合成器友好的属性。 - **可撤销是设计的一部分。** 关掉就什么都不剩。 *同一个界面，换一张壁纸 —— 面板、细线、文字色全部从新图重算。*

dsh-image-skin README · 用法：**设置 → 图片皮肤。** 两块，可以分开用：

**「贴图」** —— 换画面：

- **正在编辑** —— 一个分段控件，选 浅色模式 / 深色模式，也就是*你现在在配哪一套图*。
  切换时界面主题会跟着切，方便边配边看。
- **界面区域** 和 **角标贴图** —— 每个区域一张卡：缩略图、名字、这张图的来源
  （`浅色专用` / `两模式共用` / `未设置`），以及它的控件。
- **全局效果** —— 面板不透明度、视频播放速率。
- **存储** —— `清理未使用图片`：把不再被任何区域引用的文件收掉。

**「配色」** —— 让界面跟着画面变（**要先进「贴图」给「窗口」放一张图**，颜色是从那张图里取的）：

dsh-image-skin README · 用法：- **深浅档位（0 – 4，无级）** —— 0 最淡（只描一圈细线），往上逐级加深，并跟着画面里的光走；
  拖动时**立刻**在界面上看到结果。
- **配色强度** —— 三条路线，差别一眼可见：
  - `整屏染色` —— 每个面都带色，描边到处都有，像被泡在颜色里；
  - `只染三处` —— 面保持中性，只有选中项 / 焦点框 / 一条分隔线有色；
  - `双声部` —— 面借主色，交互色用画面里的**第二个**色相。
- **取自壁纸** —— 直接给你看取到的那几个颜色，以及识别出的材质（天空 / 纸 / 木 / 水 / 霓虹）。

dsh-image-skin README · 用法：| 控件 | 含义 |
|---|---|
| 上传 | 图片、GIF、`mp4` / `webm`（≤ 24 MB） |
| 通用图 | 两个模式共用一张，除非某个模式单独覆盖 |
| 启用 | 按区域开关 |
| 填充 | `cover` / `contain` / `tile`（区域用） |
| 编辑位置 | 角标用 —— 拖动挪位置，拖角缩放 |
| 面板不透明度 | 一个滑块管所有 DSH 面板 |
| 输入框不透明度 | 输入框 / 下拉框 / 文本域单独一档（默认 95%，比面板实） |
| 皮肤包 | 导出 / 导入整份皮肤（不含 API Key） |

**「皮肤包」** —— 在「贴图」最下面：把设置和所有被引用的图片打包成
`dsh-image-skin-日期.pack.json`，或把这样的文件贴回来。导入只补齐缺的图、不删任何文件；
同名文件跳过，不覆盖；包里的 `accentApiKey` 会被忽略（收包那台机器保留自己的 key）。

全部取色与配色**在本机完成**：不联网、不花钱、不需要 key。

dsh-image-skin README · 兼容性：开发与测试环境：`@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.5-rc.1`。

DSH 是一个基于 Cordis 的应用：这个插件是 web profile 里的一行，向宿主贡献一个设置命名空间、
向浏览器贡献一个 `settings.section` 页面。区域宿主是靠 **CSS-module 类名后缀**定位的
（`_centerCol`、`_sidebarCol`、`_hero`、`_pane`、`_composerSeat`……），不是靠哈希前缀；
但它们仍然是 DSH 的内部结构：某个版本改了这些名字，区域定位就会失效。
面板透明只覆盖文档里写明的主题 token
（`--dsw-alias-bg-base`、`--dsw-alias-bg-layer-1/2`、`--dsw-alias-bg-overlay`、
`--dsw-specific-sidebar-fill`、`--dsw-specific-app-shell`），别的都不碰。

dsh-image-skin README · 开发：```powershell
npm install
npm run build       # src/index.ts -> lib/index.js（ESM 宿主半）
                    # src/client/index.ts -> lib/client.js（浏览器半，ModuleLoader 格式）
npm run watch       # 改动即重建

`lib/` 是**特意提交进仓库**的 —— DSH 加载的就是构建产物；`prepublishOnly` 会在发布前重建，
所以发出去的包不会和 `src/` 脱节。

dsh-image-skin README · 扩展：1. 在 `src/index.ts` 的 `IMAGE_AREAS` 里加一个 id —— 设置 schema 由它生成；
2. 在 `src/client/index.ts` 的 `AREAS` 里加同样的 id 和标签；
3. 在 `REGION_SELECTORS` 里加一条，如果它要加 DOM，记得在 `disposeSkinDom()` 里清掉。
